items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: Clayton “Sunshine” Duerr, who played with Louie Prima and, or Mezz Mezzrow.

ctx.x: And so do you pursue this in higher education? How did this passion delve into a career?

Okay, when I went to college — oh I played guitar all throughout high school, pretty much on my own. I mean I am a self-taught guitar player. I didn’t take lessons. And I just listened a lot, I got the Mel Bay books for guitar and I went through the whole chord system so I could have a system. I didn’t want just a bunch of chords, I wanted a system so that I could play whatever was put in front of me by just using this system. So I did that. Of course I’ve since learned I was playing these crazy chords, didn’t…
And this was at what school?
